mintAuthority.summary: HLSCOPE uses Securitize DSToken UUPS proxies on Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, Plume, and Tron. The four EVM deployments share owner EOA 0x59c1eAcE...76Ee; Tron uses owner EOA TGmCDF...6huia. Both reviewed owners hold the trust-service MASTER role on their respective reviewed branches, which authorizes issuance and UUPS upgrades. No permissionless mint route exists.

sources.label: Hamilton Lane and Securitize HLSCOPE NAV integration

review.evidence: The full five-deployment registry was re-verified on 2026-07-14. Exact-block EVM reads resolved implementations 0xa2f6...62c9 (Ethereum block 25531417), 0x5e98...2e0b (Polygon block 90222365), 0x05ea...63ae (Optimism block 154219883), and 0x0d12...c344 (Plume block 81057700); each proxy had a zero EIP-1967 admin slot and returned shared code-empty owner EOA 0x59c1...76Ee. Plume's trust service returned MASTER for that owner. Tronscan and TronGrid identified Tron proxy TSwy...TPht1X, implementation TPEA...PrTFT, trust service THCi...zvau, and non-contract owner TGmC...6huia with MASTER role. Verified DSToken implementations gate privileged issuance at ISSUER-or-above and UUPS upgrades at MASTER. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: HLSCOPE uses RedStone TSSO to deliver issuer-provided NAV for pricing and redemptions, but no dated independent supply-to-fund-assets reconciliation was found. Its Rule 506(c) and Investment Company Act Section 3(c)(7) exemptions do not prudentially supervise the fund. Re-verified at Ethereum block 25575167 on 2026-07-20: HLSCOPE 0xda2ffa104356688e74d9340519b8c17f00d7752e still returns owner() = 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee and its EIP-1967 implementation slot still resolves to 0xa2f6ef3144753f31fcd728910b96a92bbbb462c9. Economic-control adjudication: the shared code-empty owner EOA holds the Securitize trust-service MASTER role, which authorizes both issuance at ISSUER-or-above and UUPS upgrades, with no on-chain cap, no multisig, no timelock, and no independent bound, so the mint cap is economically unbounded (the fund's offering documents constrain the issuer legally, not on-chain). Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer EOAs can issue and upgrade across all five deployments, while NAV reporting does not reconcile token supply to fund assets and no prudential product supervisor is evidenced. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: Securitize, Hamilton Lane, SEC filings, and the RedStone NAV material disclose fund valuation but no aggregate token-supply reconciliation across the five deployments, so reconciliation remains unknown. Reconciliation review 2026-08-16: Securitize/Hamilton Lane materials and the SEC Form D establish a NAV-priced, qualified-purchaser fund share, while RedStone publishes a daily NAV feed; DefiLlama's attestation index reports no attestation found. No named examiner or other dated recurring artifact reconciling liabilities across all five token deployments to fund assets was found, so reconciliation remains unknown.
